    "import numpy as np\n",

   "source": [
    "model = cv2.imread('image_01.png',0)\n",
    "withglass = cv2.imread('image_02.png',0)\n",

   "source": [
    "# Cascade Files"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 15,
   "id": "3722f843-a679-4e2d-a369-0d7fa3c333ef",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "name": "stdout",
     "output_type": "stream",
     "text": [
      "Face cascade loaded successfully!\n",
      "C:\\Users\\admin\\anaconda3\\Lib\\site-packages\\cv2\\data\\haarcascade_frontalface_default.xml\n"
     ]
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "face_cascade_path = cv2.data.haarcascades + 'haarcascade_frontalface_default.xml'\n",
    "\n",
    "face_cascade = cv2.CascadeClassifier(face_cascade_path)\n",
    "\n",
    "if face_cascade.empty():\n",
    "    raise RuntimeError(\n",
    "        f\"Face cascade could not be loaded.\\nPath: {face_cascade_path}\"\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Face cascade loaded successfully!\")\n",
    "print(face_cascade_path)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "markdown",
   "id": "1a809656-1fa0-4385-bb56-71a5966312f6",
   "metadata": {},
   "source": [
    "# Face Detection"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 16,
   "id": "d2a2278f-c7de-4150-ba81-670a43c2b06e",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def detect_face(img):\n",
    "    face_img = img.copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Convert to grayscale if the image is colored\n",
    "    if len(face_img.shape) == 3:\n",
    "        gray = cv2.cvtColor(face_img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        gray = face_img\n",
    "\n",
    "    face_rects = face_cascade.detectMultiScale(\n",
    "        gray,\n",
    "        scaleFactor=1.1,\n",
    "        minNeighbors=5,\n",
    "        minSize=(30, 30)\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "    for (x, y, w, h) in face_rects:\n",
    "        cv2.rectangle(\n",
    "            face_img,\n",
    "            (x, y),\n",
    "            (x + w, y + h),\n",
    "            (255, 255, 255),\n",
    "            3\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "    return face_img"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 17,
   "id": "2c405ca5-1efa-44fd-9d19-459bfe783da4",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1000x800 with 1 Axes>"
      ]
     },
     "metadata": {},
     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "result = detect_face(withglass)\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))\n",
    "plt.imshow(result, cmap='gray')\n",
    "plt.title(\"Face Detection - Model with Glass\")\n",
    "plt.axis('off')\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]
  },

  {

   "metadata": {},

     "text": [
      "Eye cascade loaded successfully!\n",

   "source": [
    "eye_cascade_path = cv2.data.haarcascades + 'haarcascade_eye.xml'\n",
    "\n",
    "eye_cascade = cv2.CascadeClassifier(eye_cascade_path)\n",
    "\n",
    "if eye_cascade.empty():\n",
    "    raise RuntimeError(\n",
    "        f\"Eye cascade could not be loaded.\\nPath: {eye_cascade_path}\"\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "print(\"Eye cascade loaded successfully!\")\n",
    "print(eye_cascade_path)"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 20,
   "id": "4c723e13-851e-4ef7-a29f-01f40d1d6921",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [],
   "source": [
    "def detect_eyes(img):\n",
    "    face_img = img.copy()\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Convert to grayscale\n",
    "    if len(face_img.shape) == 3:\n",
    "        gray = cv2.cvtColor(face_img, cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)\n",
    "    else:\n",
    "        gray = face_img\n",
    "\n",
    "    # First detect faces\n",
    "    faces = face_cascade.detectMultiScale(\n",
    "        gray,\n",
    "        scaleFactor=1.1,\n",
    "        minNeighbors=5,\n",
    "        minSize=(30, 30)\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "    # Detect eyes inside each detected face\n",
    "    for (x, y, w, h) in faces:\n",
    "\n",
    "        roi_gray = gray[y:y+h, x:x+w]\n",
    "\n",
    "        eyes = eye_cascade.detectMultiScale(\n",
    "            roi_gray,\n",
    "            scaleFactor=1.1,\n",
    "            minNeighbors=5,\n",
    "            minSize=(15, 15)\n",
    "        )\n",
    "\n",
    "        for (ex, ey, ew, eh) in eyes:\n",
    "\n",
    "            cv2.rectangle(\n",
    "                face_img,\n",
    "                (x + ex, y + ey),\n",
    "                (x + ex + ew, y + ey + eh),\n",
    "                (255, 255, 255),\n",
    "                2\n",
    "            )\n",
    "\n",
    "    return face_img"
   ]
  },
  {
   "cell_type": "code",
   "execution_count": 21,
   "id": "2e61d4ea-7c13-4937-935b-c099a1999f05",
   "metadata": {},

      ]

    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "result = detect_eyes(withglass)\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.figure(figsize=(10, 8))\n",
    "plt.imshow(result, cmap='gray')\n",
    "plt.title(\"Eye Detection - Model with Glass\")\n",
    "plt.axis('off')\n",
    "plt.show()"
   ]

  {

   "id": "be18ee6c-1e52-41d9-ba8a-4447f7465042",
   "metadata": {},
   "outputs": [
    {
     "data": {
      "image/png": "",
      "text/plain": [
       "<Figure size 1000x700 with 1 Axes>"
      ]

     "output_type": "display_data"
    }
   ],
   "source": [
    "cap = cv2.VideoCapture(0)\n",
    "\n",
    "if not cap.isOpened():\n",
    "    raise RuntimeError(\n",
    "        \"Could not open the camera. \"\n",
    "        \"Check whether your webcam is connected or being used by another application.\"\n",
    "    )\n",
    "\n",
    "plt.ion()\n",
    "\n",
    "fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, 7))\n",
    "\n",
    "ret, frame = cap.read()\n",
    "\n",
    "if not ret:\n",
    "    cap.release()\n",
    "    plt.close(fig)\n",
    "    raise RuntimeError(\"Could not read the first frame from the camera.\")\n",
    "\n",
    "frame = detect_face(frame)\n",
    "\n",
    "im = ax.imshow(cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB))\n",
    "ax.set_title(\"Video Face Detection\")\n",
    "ax.axis('off')\n",
    "\n",
    "while plt.fignum_exists(fig.number):\n",
    "\n",
    "    ret, frame = cap.read()\n",
    "\n",
    "    if not ret:\n",
    "        print(\"Could not read frame from camera.\")\n",
    "        break\n",
    "\n",
    "    frame = detect_face(frame)\n",
    "\n",
    "    im.set_data(cv2.cvtColor(frame, cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB))\n",
    "\n",
    "    plt.pause(0.01)\n",
    "\n",
    "cap.release()\n",
    "plt.ioff()\n",
    "plt.close(fig)"
   ]
  },
